text:
Kira: Quick heads-up — proposing we move Atlas-40B quant bring-up onto this week's prioritization huddle. Need a short scoring pass and rollout owners.
Matt: Sounds good. Do we have baseline evals vs current 34B in the repo?
Sana: I ran an initial 8-bit pass on a dev cluster last night. Latency looks promising, some small quality drift. Will paste the short numbers shortly.
Carlos (PM): Roadmap context: this could be a blocker or enabler for a search-latency SLA we promised. If perf gains are >25% with acceptable quality delta, it's high priority.
Jordan: Ops question — can we spin a 4xA100 test pool for canary? Need confirmation on quota. ETA ~tomorrow if approved.
Sana: Quick summary: `baseline (34B fp16) -> ppl 12.0, median token latency 45ms; atlas-40b (int8-ish) -> ppl 12.4, median token latency 29ms` Rough numbers, still running evals. No obvious regression in closed-book QA set so far.
Kira: Proposed prioritization rubric (quick vote): Impact (1-5), Risk (1-5), Infra Effort (1-5), Compliance/Data drift (1-5). Threshold: total >=12 => canary.
Matt: Agree with rubric. Suggest adding "Eval surface" note: chat-turn-level + retrieval rerank + embeddings sanity.
Sana: I can run the chat-turn-level eval and sample 500 inference pairs today. Will include hallucination and token-overlap checks.
Carlos (PM): For roadmap alignment: if this goes to canary next week we can hit the integration milestone for Dedicated customers in the following sprint. So time-sensitive.
Kira: Owner calls — Sana volunteers for quant experiment lead and initial evals. Jordan to own infra provisioning. Matt to own offline scorer and regression thresholds. Carlos will own stakeholder signoff.
Jordan: Filed infra request: `#ticket-4321` for 4xA100 pool. ops-bot: resource request submitted.
ops-bot: Ticket created: TICKET-4321 — Test pool request (4xA100), priority: medium.
Sana: Draft bring-up checklist (short):
- run baseline evals (ppl, rouge, safety checks)
- run quant config sweep (8-bit, q4 variants)
- memory/KV cache validation with typical convo lengths
- run full regression suite (chat, rerank, embeddings)
- smoke canary with fallback to 34B pinned model
- dashboards + alerting (latency, token cost, quality degradation)
Kira: Add a rollout policy: canary traffic 2% -> 10% -> 50% over 72h with auto-fallback on quality or latency SLO breach.
Matt: I'll add automatic evaluation gating: if chat-turn BLEU/EM drops >3% or hallucination rate increases >2pp, trigger fallback.
Carlos (PM): Quick vote: slot for next Wed canary if infra confirms. React with :thumbsup: to approve.
Jordan: +1 but infra needs until EOD tomorrow to confirm pool.
Sana: I'll post the first eval artifact link in this thread by EOD. If metrics hold, we aim for canary Wed.
Kira: Remember to pin model versions and keep the older 34B model as immediate fallback. Also add a short runbook for oncall.
Matt: Noted — will draft gating checks and runbook snippets.
Kira: Thanks all. We'll reconvene in the prioritization huddle Tue 10:00 for final scoring. Closing thread until then — please drop results here when ready. :white_check_mark:
